Class BmuService

java.lang.Object
com.hospital.admissions.service.BmuService
@Service public class BmuService extends Object
Core business service for the Bed Management Unit (BMU).

Implements clinical triage queue prioritization, constraint-based bed recommendation scoring, strict multi-bed gender and infection safety invariant verification, clinician override audits, external sister hospital subacute diversion workflows, and batch holding ward flex-management.

    • getPrioritizedQueue

      public List<AdmissionRequest> getPrioritizedQueue()
      Retrieves the prioritized queue of admission requests waiting for bed allocation. Requests are ordered by effective acuity tier (Tier 1 critical first), telemetry requirement, and submission timestamp (FIFO).
      Returns:
      sorted list of pending AdmissionRequest instances.

    • allocateBed

      @Transactional public AdmissionRequest allocateBed(UUID admissionRequestId, UUID bedId, Integer rank, Double score, String overrideReason)
      Allocates a bed to a patient, enforcing hard clinical safety invariants (biological gender cohorting and infection isolation) and auditing soft constraint overrides.
      Parameters:
      admissionRequestId - the unique identifier of the admission request.
      bedId - the unique identifier of the target bed.
      rank - the solver recommendation rank (or null if unranked).
      score - the recommendation composite score (or null).
      overrideReason - clinical justification reason if overriding solver recommendations.
      Returns:
      the updated AdmissionRequest.
